  # Quick fix for my different use of constraints files: 
    l_definitions$prepare_constraints <- TRUE
    if (l_definitions$prepare_constraints == TRUE) {
  # Set up each constraint

  ### C01: Urban/Rural & Household Master Constraint ### 
      
    # load urban rural dataset 
    dt_EW_hh_urban_rural <- data.table::fread("Input/Census_EW/Rural_Urban_Classification_(2021)_of_LSOAs_in_EW.csv")
    dt_EW_hh_urban_rural <- copy(dt_EW_hh_urban_rural[, .(LSOA21CD, urban_rural = Urban_rural_flag)])
    setkey(dt_EW_hh_urban_rural, LSOA21CD)
      
    # establish total number of households 
    dt_EW_master_number_hh <- data.table::fread("Input/Census_EW/dt_number_households.csv")
    dt_EW_master_number_hh <- copy(dt_EW_master_number_hh[, .(LSOA21CD = geography_code,
                                                              N_hh = obs_value)])

    # bring together
    dt_EW_hh_urban_rural <- merge(dt_EW_hh_urban_rural, dt_EW_master_number_hh, by = "LSOA21CD",
                              all.x = TRUE, all.y = TRUE)

    # recode urban - rural
    dt_EW_hh_urban_rural[, `:=`(urban = NA_integer_, rural = NA_integer_)]
    dt_EW_hh_urban_rural[urban_rural == "Urban", `:=`(urban = N_hh, rural = 0)]
    dt_EW_hh_urban_rural[urban_rural == "Rural", `:=`(rural = N_hh, urban = 0)]
    dt_EW_hh_urban_rural <- dt_EW_hh_urban_rural[, .(areacode = LSOA21CD, urban, rural)]
    setkey(dt_EW_hh_urban_rural, areacode)

    # deep copy to obtain master number of HH for proportional adjustments 
    dt_EW_master_number_hh <- copy(dt_EW_hh_urban_rural[, .(LSOA21CD = areacode, 
                                                      row_sum_master = urban + rural)])

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

  ### c02: HH Heating ###
    dt_EW_hh_heating <- data.table::fread("Input/Census_EW/census_2021_c02_hh_heating.csv", # 1 = NO / 2 = YES Central Heating
                                        header = TRUE, skip = 0)
    dt_EW_hh_heating <- janitor::clean_names(dt_EW_hh_heating)
    dt_EW_hh_heating <- .BasicClean(dt_EW_hh_heating)
    dt_EW_hh_heating <- copy(dt_EW_hh_heating[type_of_central_heating_in_household_3_categories_code != -9L,
                                            .(LSOA21CD = lower_layer_super_output_areas_code,
                                              hh_heating = type_of_central_heating_in_household_3_categories_code,
                                              N_hh = observation)])

    # recoding; 
    dt_EW_hh_heating[, hh_heating := as.character(hh_heating)]
    dt_EW_hh_heating[hh_heating == "1", hh_heating := "without_heating"]
    dt_EW_hh_heating[hh_heating == "2", hh_heating := "with_heating"]
    dt_EW_hh_heating <- data.table::dcast(dt_EW_hh_heating, LSOA21CD ~ hh_heating)

    # reducing; not required
    dt_EW_hh_heating <- copy(dt_EW_hh_heating)

    # apply proportional adjustment ("proportional boosting") 
    dt_EW_hh_heating_dim <- dim(dt_EW_hh_heating)[[2]]
    dt_EW_hh_heating[, row_sum_old := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = 2:dt_EW_hh_heating_dim]
    dt_EW_hh_heating <- merge(x = dt_EW_hh_heating, y = dt_EW_master_number_hh, by = "LSOA21CD")
    dt_EW_hh_heating <- .PropAdjustZero(dt_in = dt_EW_hh_heating,
                                      total_in = "row_sum_master",
                                      definitions = l_definitions)

    # proportional adjustment diagnostics
    dt_EW_hh_heating[, row_sum_new := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = 2:dt_EW_hh_heating_dim]
    dt_EW_hh_heating_diag <- .PropDiag(dt_in = dt_EW_hh_heating)
    # data.table::fwrite(dt_EW_hh_heating_diag, "Output/Constraints/diag_c02_dt_EW_hh_heating.csv")

    # reduce, key and safe constraints table
    dt_EW_hh_heating <- copy(dt_EW_hh_heating[,1:dt_EW_hh_heating_dim])
    data.table::setnames(dt_EW_hh_heating, old = l_definitions$agg_level_EW, new = "areacode")
    setkey(dt_EW_hh_heating, areacode)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

  ### c03: HH Type ###
    dt_EW_hh_type <- data.table::fread("Input/Census_EW/census_2021_c03_hh_type.csv",
                                      header = TRUE, skip = 0)
    dt_EW_hh_type <- janitor::clean_names(dt_EW_hh_type)
    dt_EW_hh_type <- copy(dt_EW_hh_type[household_type_12_categories_code != -8L,
                                      .(LSOA21CD = lower_layer_super_output_areas_code,
                                        hh_type  = household_type_12_categories,
                                        N_hh = observation)])

    # recoding and reducing
    dt_EW_hh_type <- data.table::dcast(dt_EW_hh_type, LSOA21CD ~ hh_type)
    dt_EW_hh_type <- janitor::clean_names(dt_EW_hh_type)
    dt_EW_hh_type <- .BasicClean(dt_EW_hh_type)

    # one_person_household
    dt_EW_hh_type[, one_person_household := one_person_household]

    # lone_parent_children
    dt_EW_hh_type[, lone_parent := 
                  lone_parent_household_dependent_children + 
                  lone_parent_household_no_dependent_children]

    # couple_married_civil_no_children
    dt_EW_hh_type[, couple_married_civil_no_children := 
                  civil_partnership_couple_household_no_dependent_children + 
                  married_couple_household_no_dependent_children + 
                  cohabiting_couple_household_no_dependent_children]

    # couple_married_civil_with_children
    dt_EW_hh_type[, couple_married_civil_with_children :=
                  civil_partnership_couple_household_dependent_children + 
                  cohabiting_couple_household_dependent_children + 
                  married_couple_household_dependent_children]

    # other
    dt_EW_hh_type[, other := multi_person_household_all_students + 
                  multi_person_household_other]

    # reduce 
    dt_EW_hh_type <- copy(dt_EW_hh_type[, .(LSOA21CD = lsoa21cd,
                                          one_person_household,
                                          lone_parent,
                                          couple_married_civil_no_children,
                                          couple_married_civil_with_children,
                                          other)])

    # apply proportional adjustment ("proportional boosting") 
    dt_EW_hh_type_dim <- dim(dt_EW_hh_type)[[2]]
    dt_EW_hh_type[, row_sum_old := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = 2:dt_EW_hh_type_dim]
    dt_EW_hh_type <- merge(x = dt_EW_hh_type, y = dt_EW_master_number_hh, by = "LSOA21CD")
    dt_EW_hh_type <- .PropAdjustZero(dt_in = dt_EW_hh_type,
                                    total_in = "row_sum_master",
                                    definitions = l_definitions)

    # proportional adjustment diagnostics
    dt_EW_hh_type[, row_sum_new := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = 2:dt_EW_hh_type_dim]
    dt_EW_hh_type_diag <- .PropDiag(dt_in = dt_EW_hh_type)
    #data.table::fwrite(dt_EW_hh_type_diag, "Output/Constraints/diag_c03_dt_EW_hh_type.csv")

    # reduce, key and safe constraints table
    dt_EW_hh_type <- copy(dt_EW_hh_type[,1:dt_EW_hh_type_dim])
    data.table::setnames(dt_EW_hh_type, old = l_definitions$agg_level_EW, new = "areacode")
    setkey(dt_EW_hh_type, areacode)
    # save in next step

    # load data

    dt_EW_ind_sex_age <- janitor::clean_names(dt_EW_ind_sex_age)
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age <- copy(dt_EW_ind_sex_age[,
                                              .(LSOA21CD  = lower_layer_super_output_areas_code,
                                                sex  = sex_2_categories, 
                                                age  = age_6_categories,
                                                N = observation)])
    # recode sex and age 
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[sex == "Female", sex := "f"]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[sex == "Male", sex := "m"]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[age == "Aged 15 years and under", age := "00_15"]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[age == "Aged 16 to 24 years", age := "16_24"]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[age == "Aged 25 to 34 years", age := "25_34"]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[age == "Aged 35 to 49 years", age := "35_49"]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[age == "Aged 50 to 64 years", age := "50_64"]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[age == "Aged 65 years and over", age := "65p"]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[, sex_age := paste0(sex,"_",age)]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age <- copy(dt_EW_ind_sex_age[, .(LSOA21CD, sex_age, N)])
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age <- data.table::dcast(dt_EW_ind_sex_age, LSOA21CD ~ sex_age)
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age <- .BasicClean(dt_EW_ind_sex_age)

    # apply proportional adjustment ("proportional boosting") 
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dim <- dim(dt_EW_ind_sex_age)[[2]]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[, row_sum_old := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = 2:dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dim] 
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age <- merge(x = dt_EW_ind_sex_age,
                              y = dt_EW_master_number_ind_all[, .(LSOA21CD, row_sum_master)],
                              by = "LSOA21CD")
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age <- .PropAdjustZero(
      dt_in = dt_EW_ind_sex_age, total_in = "row_sum_master", definitions = l_definitions)

    # proportional adjustment diagnostics
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age[, row_sum_new := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = 2:dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dim]
    dt_EW_ind_sex_age_diag <- .PropDiag(dt_in = dt_EW_ind_sex_age)
    #data.table::fwrite(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_diag, "Output/Constraints/diag_c09_dt_EW_ind_sex_age.csv")

    # still based on sex and age, just aggregated to hh later on

      census_as <- data.table::fread("Input/Census_EW/census2021_c09_ind_age_sex.csv")
      dis_probs_as <- data.table::fread("Input/Census_EW/agg_cca_preds.csv") 
    # apply age/sex probabilities at individual level 
      # align colnames 
      names(census_as)[names(census_as) == "Sex (2 categories) Code"] <- "sex" 
      names(census_as)[names(census_as) == "Age (6 categories) Code"] <- "age6" 
      # simulate based on sex and age, but don't restructure data 

      dis_probs_as$age6 <- as.integer(dis_probs_as$age6)
      dis_probs_as[which(dis_probs_as$sex == 1), 'sex'] <- 3 # Get 1 out of here 
      dis_probs_as[which(dis_probs_as$sex == 2), 'sex'] <- 1 # census uses 1 as female
      dis_probs_as[which(dis_probs_as$sex == 3), 'sex'] <- 2 # census uses 2 as male 

    # Merge aggregate probabilities onto census data 
      census_dis_as <- merge(census_as, dis_probs_as, 
                              by = c("sex", "age6"))
      
      # Bernoulli draws
        # now apply probs, given the shape of the census data (totals of inds)...
        # repeat a draw for n in each cell, and then add each type of response for each cell
        # merge probabilities onto census counts by age6 and sex
        census_dis_as_sim <- merge(census_as, 
                              dis_probs_as[, .(age6, sex, p_hat)],  # only keep needed cols
                              by = c("age6", "sex"),
                              all.x = TRUE)
        # check for any unmatched groups (should be zero)
        cat("NAs in p_hat after merge:", sum(is.na(census_dis_as_sim$p_hat)), "\n")

        # Bernoulli draws: size = Observation (N people in each LSOA/age/sex group)
        set.seed(123)
        census_dis_as_sim[, n_dis_sim    := rbinom(n = .N, size = Observation, prob = p_hat)]
        census_dis_as_sim[, n_no_dis_sim := Observation - n_dis_sim]

      # match other constraints data 
        # Start from simulated data
        dt_EW_ind_dis_sim <- copy(census_dis_as_sim)

        # Create consistent ID column
        dt_EW_ind_dis_sim[, LSOA21CD := `Lower layer Super Output Areas Code`]

        # Recode core variables
        dt_EW_ind_dis_sim[, `:=`(
        sex = as.character(sex),
        age = as.character(age6)
        )]
      
      # Select and rename columns
      dt_EW_ind_dis_sim <- dt_EW_ind_dis_sim[, .(
        LSOA21CD      = LSOA21CD,
        sex           = sex,
        age           = age6,
        dis    = n_dis_sim,
        no_dis = n_no_dis_sim
      )]

      # Aggregate
      dt_EW_ind_dis_sim <- dt_EW_ind_dis_sim[
        , .(dis    = sum(dis, na.rm = TRUE),
            no_dis = sum(no_dis, na.rm = TRUE)),
        by = .(LSOA21CD, sex, age)
      ]

        # # Apply proportional adjustment ("proportional boosting")

        # # proportional adjustment diagnostics
        # dt_EW_ind_dis_sim[, row_sum_new := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = 2:dt_EW_ind_dis_sim_dim]
        # dt_EW_ind_dis_sim_diag <- .PropDiag(dt_in = dt_EW_ind_dis_sim)
        # data.table::fwrite(dt_EW_ind_dis_sim_diag, "Output/Constraints/diag_c17_dt_EW_ind_dis_sim.csv")

    # finalise constraint dataset 
      # dt_EW_ind_dis_sim <- copy(dt_EW_ind_dis_sim[,1:dt_EW_ind_dis_sim_dim])
      data.table::setnames(dt_EW_ind_dis_sim, old = l_definitions$agg_level_EW, new = "areacode")

        write.csv(dt_EW_ind_dis_sim, "Input/Census_EW/census2021_c17_ind_dis_sim.csv")

    # reshape sex and age 
      # Start from simulated data
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim <- copy(dt_EW_ind_dis_sim)
      setnames(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim, "areacode", "LSOA21CD")

      # convert wide to long 
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim <- melt(
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim,
      id.vars = c("LSOA21CD", "sex", "age"),
      measure.vars = c("dis", "no_dis"),
      variable.name = "dis_status",
      value.name = "N"
      )

      # recode 
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[, age := as.character(age)]

      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[sex == "1", sex := "f"]
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[sex == "2", sex := "m"]
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[age == "1", age := "00_15"]
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[age == "2", age := "16_24"]
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[age == "3", age := "25_34"]
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[age == "4", age := "35_49"]
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[age == "5", age := "50_64"]
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[age == "6", age := "65p"]

      # dis (from melted column names)
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[dis_status == "dis", dis_status := "dis1_sim"]
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[dis_status == "no_dis", dis_status := "dis0_sim"]

      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[, sex_age_dis_sim := paste0(sex,"_",age,"_",dis_status)]
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim <- copy(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[, .(LSOA21CD, sex_age_dis_sim, N)])
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim <- data.table::dcast(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim, LSOA21CD ~ sex_age_dis_sim)
      dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim <- .BasicClean(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim)
    
      # apply proportional adjustment ("proportional boosting") 
        dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim_dim <- dim(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim)[[2]]
        dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[, row_sum_old := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = 2:dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim_dim] 
        dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim <- merge(
          x = dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim,
          y = dt_EW_master_number_ind_all[, .(LSOA21CD, row_sum_master)],
          by = "LSOA21CD"
        )
        
        dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim <- .PropAdjustZero(
          dt_in = dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim, total_in = "row_sum_master", definitions = l_definitions)

        # proportional adjustment diagnostics
        dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[, row_sum_new := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = 2:dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim_dim]
        dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim_diag <- .PropDiag(dt_in = dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim)
        data.table::fwrite(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim_diag, "Output/Constraints/diag_c19_dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim.csv")

        # finalise constraint dataset 
          dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim <- copy(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim[,1:dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim_dim])
          data.table::setnames(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim, old = "LSOA21CD", new = "areacode")
          setkey(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim, areacode)

      # save 
        write.csv(dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim, "Input/Census_EW/census2021_c19_ind_sex_age_dis_sim.csv")

  ### Export Constraints in Go Format ###
    # bring all constraints into a an mget object, all files have to be in similar format
      l_EW_cons <- copy(mget(c("dt_EW_hh_urban_rural", "dt_EW_hh_heating", "dt_EW_hh_type", 
                                  # "dt_EW_hh_tenure_presence_child", "dt_EW_hh_cars_hh_size", "dt_EW_hh_beds_hh_size",
                                  # "dt_EW_hh_employment_hh_size", "dt_EW_hh_carer", "dt_EW_ind_sex_age",
                                  "dt_EW_ind_education", "dt_EW_ind_ethnicity", # "dt_EW_ind_partnership", 
                                  "dt_EW_ind_health", # "dt_EW_ind_activity", "dt_EW_hh_deprivation", 
                                  # "dt_EW_ind_dis", 
                                  # "dt_EW_ind_dis_sim", 
                                  "dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis", 
                                  "dt_EW_ind_sex_age_dis_sim")))

        for (i in seq_along(l_EW_cons)) {
          first_col <- names(l_EW_cons[[i]])[1]
          if (first_col != "areacode") {
            setnames(l_EW_cons[[i]], old = first_col, new = "areacode")
          }
        }

      # rename all columns to start with "objectname" and "%" 
          for (i in 1:length(l_EW_cons)) {
            new_name <- names(l_EW_cons)[i]
            setnames(l_EW_cons[[i]], 
                    old = names(l_EW_cons[[i]])[-1], 
                    new = paste0(new_name,"%",names(l_EW_cons[[i]])[-1]))
          }

      # merge all columns 
        dt_EW_constraints <- data.table::data.table(dt_EW_master_number_ind_all[, .(LSOA21CD, population = row_sum_master)])
        for (i in 1: length(l_EW_cons)) {
          # merge will ensure that all elements are intersecting (N=46,363))
          dt_EW_constraints  <- merge(x = dt_EW_constraints, y = l_EW_cons[[i]], 
                                by.x = "LSOA21CD", by.y = "areacode")
        }


      # save go format dataset
        setnames(dt_EW_constraints, old = names(dt_EW_constraints), new = sub("^dt_EW_", "", names(dt_EW_constraints)))
        data.table::fwrite(x = dt_EW_constraints, file = "Output/Constraints/dt_EW_constraints.csv")

      # save supplementary files 
        data.table::fwrite(x = dt_EW_master_number_hh, file = "Output/Constraints/dt_EW_master_number_hh.csv")
        data.table::fwrite(x = dt_EW_master_number_ind_all, file = "Output/Constraints/dt_EW_master_number_ind_all.csv")
        data.table::fwrite(x = dt_EW_master_number_ind_16over, file = "Output/Constraints/dt_EW_master_number_ind_16over.csv")

      # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

  # Check

      library(data.table)

      target_order <- c(

        "hh_heating%with_heating", "hh_heating%without_heating",
        "hh_type%one_person_household", "hh_type%lone_parent",

        "ind_ethnicity%african", "ind_ethnicity%asian", "ind_ethnicity%caribbean_black",
        "ind_ethnicity%ethnicity_other", "ind_ethnicity%mixed", "ind_ethnicity%white",
        "ind_health%bad", "ind_health%fair", "ind_health%good", "ind_health%very_good",
        "ind_sex_age_dis%f_00_15_dis0", "ind_sex_age_dis%f_16_24_dis0", "ind_sex_age_dis%f_25_34_dis0",
        "ind_sex_age_dis%f_35_49_dis0", "ind_sex_age_dis%f_50_64_dis0", "ind_sex_age_dis%f_65p_dis0",
        "ind_sex_age_dis%m_00_15_dis0", "ind_sex_age_dis%m_16_24_dis0", "ind_sex_age_dis%m_25_34_dis0",
        "ind_sex_age_dis%m_35_49_dis0", "ind_sex_age_dis%m_50_64_dis0", "ind_sex_age_dis%m_65p_dis0",
        "ind_sex_age_dis%f_00_15_dis1", "ind_sex_age_dis%f_16_24_dis1", "ind_sex_age_dis%f_25_34_dis1",
        "ind_sex_age_dis%f_35_49_dis1", "ind_sex_age_dis%f_50_64_dis1", "ind_sex_age_dis%f_65p_dis1",
        "ind_sex_age_dis%m_00_15_dis1", "ind_sex_age_dis%m_16_24_dis1", "ind_sex_age_dis%m_25_34_dis1",
        "ind_sex_age_dis%m_35_49_dis1", "ind_sex_age_dis%m_50_64_dis1", "ind_sex_age_dis%m_65p_dis1"
      )

      dt <- copy(dt_EW_constraints)
      setDT(dt)

      # ---- non-sim version ----
      non_sim <- dt[, .SD, .SDcols = c("LSOA21CD", "population",
                                        grep("_sim", names(dt), invert = TRUE, value = TRUE)[-(1:2)])]
      setnames(non_sim, old = names(non_sim), new = gsub("dis", "dis", names(non_sim)))
      setcolorder(non_sim, c("LSOA21CD", "population", target_order))

      # ---- sim version ----
      sim <- dt[, .SD, .SDcols = c("LSOA21CD", "population",
                                    grep("^hh_|^ind_education%|^ind_ethnicity%|^ind_health%",
                                        names(dt), value = TRUE),
                                    grep("_sim", names(dt), value = TRUE))]
      setnames(sim, old = names(sim),
              new = gsub("_sim$", "", gsub("dis_sim%", "dis%", names(sim))))
      setcolorder(sim, c("LSOA21CD", "population", target_order))

      # save 
      fwrite(non_sim, "data/England/census2021_e_go_10.csv")
      fwrite(sim,     "data/England/census2021_e_go_10_sim.csv")

      # check both match the target exactly
      identical(names(non_sim)[-(1:2)], target_order)
      identical(names(sim)[-(1:2)], target_order)
